description: Car Parking Zones is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the type and location of car parking zones located in Ballarat. The information was collected as the zones were established. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the locations of Ballarat's car parking zones. The dataset is typically updated monthly on an automated schedule. Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are car parking, ods-dataset-realtime0, smarter parking. It offers 1 resource(s) in API. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
